sources.source_name: Tesla: Q4 2020 vehicle production and deliveries
sources.notes: Preliminary delivery report, 499,550 rounded for player readability; no earnings claim.

The 737 MAX grounding and pandemic hurt results. Revenue fell to $58.2 billion and the annual net loss reached $11.9 billion, including a $6.5 billion 777X charge. MAX deliveries resumed in late 2020.

2024 revenue fell 14% to $66.5 billion, with 348 commercial-airplane deliveries and an $11.8 billion annual net loss. The IAM strike, commercial-airplane charges and defense-program losses weighed on results.

Tesla delivered roughly 500,000 vehicles in 2020 and earned $721 million attributable to common shareholders, its first full-year GAAP profit. Regulatory-credit revenue was $1.58 billion. Model Y deliveries began in 2020, while Model 3 and Shanghai production expanded.

Deliveries rose from about 500,000 in 2020 to 1.789 million in 2024, but fell 1% from 2023. Annual operating income fell 20% to $7.076 billion. Energy-storage deployments more than doubled. Forward-looking robotaxi plans are treated as hopes, not delivered results.
